card.name: Linking words after comparison or relation terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (than, to, with, of, and) that follow a word of comparison, relation or direction and come before the thing being compared or related. Examples: 'larger than', 'opposed to', 'connection with'.

modes.label: Comparison and relation links
modes.description: A preposition such as than, to or with right after a word like larger, opposed, related or connection.
modes.example: a megabyte is 1,000 times larger<< than>> a kilobyte, a gigabyte

modes.label: Direction and position links
modes.description: Of or and after a compass or position phrase, before the reference place.
modes.example: ascending about 240 metres or 787 feet to the northeast<< of>> the palace), the city was established in

modes.label: Other mid-phrase words
modes.description: Scattered words partway through a phrase, such as be, almost or times.
modes.example: 10 mg twice daily may<< be>> switched to XELJANZ XR

card.plain: It fires on small linking words like than, to or of that come before the second item in a comparison or relation.
